OFF_BY_ONE_LOOP_BOUNDARY.targeted: This loop keeps going while `{condition}`, so on its last pass the index is {array}.length. Is there an element of {array} at that position?

INCORRECT_CONDITIONAL_OPERATOR.targeted: `{assignment}` stores a value in {variable} instead of comparing it, and the condition then tests whatever was stored. Which operator compares two values?

ARRAY_LENGTH_INDEX_MISUSE.targeted: `{access}` reads position {array}.length. If the positions of {array} start at 0, which position is its last one?

STRING_EQUALITY_WITH_OPERATOR.targeted: `{comparison}` asks whether both sides are the very same String object, not whether they hold the same text. Which String method compares the text itself?

LOOP_UPDATE_WRONG_DIRECTION.targeted: The loop keeps going while `{condition}`, and every pass does `{update}`. Does that bring the counter closer to making the condition false, or take it further away?

UNREACHABLE_CODE_AFTER_RETURN.targeted: `{statement}` comes after a return in the same block, so the method has always left before it gets there. When did you want this line to run?

MISSING_BREAK_IN_SWITCH.targeted: After the statements under `{case}` finish, nothing stops execution, so the next case's statements run as well. Is that meant to happen here?

EMPTY_CONDITIONAL_BODY.targeted: In `{statement}` the semicolon straight after the condition is the whole body, so the block underneath runs either way. What is the condition controlling at the moment?

SELF_ASSIGNMENT.targeted: `{assignment}` puts the value of {variable} back into {variable}, so nothing changes. Which value did you mean to store there?

ALWAYS_TRUE_OR_CONDITION.targeted: Try `{condition}` with a few real values of {variable}. Is there any value at all that makes the whole condition false?

IGNORED_STRING_METHOD_RESULT.targeted: `{call}` builds a new String, but nothing keeps it, so {target} is exactly the same afterwards. Where should the new String go?

DIVISION_BY_ZERO_LITERAL.targeted: `{expression}` divides by the literal 0, which stops the program every time this line runs. What should the divisor really be?

CONSTANT_FALSE_LOOP_CONDITION.targeted: {variable} starts at {start}, and `{condition}` is already false for that value, so the loop body never runs at all. Which of the two numbers is not the one you meant?

DUPLICATE_IF_ELSE_CONDITION.targeted: `{condition}` was already tested earlier in this if / else-if chain, so a value that reaches this branch has already been handled above. Which situation was this branch meant for?

WHILE_VARIABLE_NOT_UPDATED.targeted: Nothing inside this loop changes {variables}, so `{condition}` gives the same answer on every pass. Which line should be changing it?

INTEGER_DIVISION_IN_DECIMAL_CONTEXT.targeted: `{expression}` divides two whole numbers, so Java drops the remainder before the answer is stored in {target}. What happens to the decimal part?

DECIMAL_EQUALITY_COMPARISON.targeted: `{comparison}` needs the two decimal values to match exactly, down to the last binary digit, and calculated values often miss by a tiny amount. How close should they be to count as equal?

POSTFIX_INCREMENT_ASSIGNED_BACK.targeted: In `{assignment}`, {variable}++ increases {variable} and then hands back its old value, which the assignment stores straight back into {variable}. What is {variable} after this line runs?

ALWAYS_FALSE_AND_CONDITION.targeted: Try `{condition}` with a few values of {variable}. Is there any value that makes both sides true at once?
